metadata.selection: Per dataset, candidate 5-view tuples have a connected co-visibility graph (edges with at least 5% overlap). Pretrained DUSt3R (224) predicted all ten pairs and DUSt3R global alignment (300 iterations, msp initialization) recovered the poses. Tuples were ranked by mean pairwise rotation error and the top 100 per dataset were kept. No tuple shares a sequence, scene, image, room or building with the Click3R training data. CO3D: the tuples come from the 499 held-out CO3D v2 test sequences of Table 1; the tuple search drew 994 loader indices, the same number per loader item as 5,000 on the larger training set. Habitat: the top 100 tuples whose scene shares no room or building with the training scenes. BlendedMVS and WildRGB-D: the top 100 tuples.

fields.dust3r_mean_rre: mean pairwise rotation error (degrees) of pretrained DUSt3R after global alignment, the selection statistic
